Overview

Chelyabinsk is a city in Chelyabinsk Oblast with a population of 1,200,000. An industrial powerhouse in the Urals, known for its metallurgy industry, and a gateway to the scenic Ural Mountains. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
